compiled:
📰 General

Nvidia Stock Surge Fuels Broad Market Rebound Following CEO Reinstatement •

The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 experienced significant gains on Monday, with the S&P 500 rising by approximately 5.6% and the Nasdaq 100 increasing by 7.9%. This surge was largely attributed to Nvidia’s stock price increase following the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO. The Dow Jones Industrial Average also saw substantial growth, driven in part by Nvidia’s performance. Investors reacted positively to the leadership change and the company’s continued prominence in the artificial intelligence sector.

🌍 World

Seal Rescued From Dangerous Situation After Becoming Wedged Between Rocks •

A seal was successfully rescued from a precarious situation in Brixham, Devon, by a coordinated team of marine rescue organizations. The British Divers Marine Life Rescue (BDMLR) collaborated with The Seal Project and the Brixham RNLI coxswain to reach the animal trapped between rocks on Saturday. Marine mammal medic Sarah Greenslade played a key role in the operation, assessing and stabilizing the seal before its safe removal. The rescue highlights the ongoing efforts to protect marine wildlife in the region.

🦅 US

Flu Cases Spike in New York Ahead of Thanksgiving, Disrupting Holiday Plans •

New York is experiencing a significant increase in reported flu cases as the state prepares for Thanksgiving celebrations. Over 43,000 New Yorkers have contracted the virus since the beginning of October. Health officials attribute the surge to increased social gatherings and the virus’s heightened transmissibility. The rise in cases is prompting caution among residents and potentially impacting holiday travel and events. Authorities are urging individuals to practice preventative measures like handwashing and vaccination.

💰 Business

Jensen Huang’s Return Sends Shockwaves Through AI Market, Hurtling Anthropic Down •

Following Jensen Huang’s announcement of his return as CEO of Nvidia, a significant surge occurred across most artificial intelligence stocks. Shares of Anthropic, a recently public AI company, experienced a notable decline on Monday despite the positive market reaction. This divergence highlights investor anticipation surrounding Nvidia’s continued dominance in AI hardware and its impact on the competitive landscape. The market’s reaction suggests a reassessment of Anthropic’s valuation relative to Nvidia’s advancements.

💻 Technology

Samsung’s One UI 9.5 Brings Refined Design and New Features Compared to 9 •

Samsung’s One UI 9.5 beta update introduces several enhancements over the previously released One UI 9. Initial observations highlight a refined visual design, particularly in the Quick Settings panel and app drawer. The update includes new features like a redesigned notification panel and improved multitasking capabilities. Samsung has accelerated the rollout of One UI 9.5, offering users an early look at the next iteration of its flagship software.

🎭 Entertainment

Shawn Levy’s 21 Laps Secures Major Feature Deal with Sony Pictures •

Shawn Levy’s production company, 21 Laps, has signed a significant overall feature film deal with Sony Pictures. The agreement follows Levy’s recent television deal with Disney’s 20th Television, solidifying his continued expansion within the entertainment industry. Sony was reportedly highly competitive in securing the deal, indicating a strong interest in the company’s future projects. Details regarding specific projects under the deal are currently undisclosed, but the partnership represents a substantial investment in 21 Laps’ creative capabilities.

🏅 Sports

NYC Mayor Mamdani Announces Surgery Following Unexpected Soccer Injury •

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani will undergo surgery this week due to an injury sustained while playing soccer with the press. The injury occurred during a friendly match last week. Mayor Mamdani described the surgery as his first, expressing his apprehension about the procedure. Medical staff have confirmed the planned operation is scheduled for later this week. Further details regarding the specific nature of the injury are not yet available.

🔬 Science

Voyager 1 Reaches Historic Milestone: One Light-Day From Earth •

NASA’s Voyager 1 spacecraft has achieved a groundbreaking milestone, becoming the first human-made object to travel one light-day from Earth. The probe, launched in 1977, surpassed this significant distance on November 18, 2026, marking a new era in space exploration. Scientists are analyzing data transmitted by the spacecraft to understand its environment and trajectory at this unprecedented distance. This achievement provides valuable insights into the interstellar medium and the outer reaches of our solar system.

🩺 Health

First Signs of Illness? Experts Outline Immediate Steps to Take •

Flu and COVID-19 activity is currently rising across the United States, prompting public health officials to advise immediate action upon experiencing symptoms. Individuals should prioritize rest and hydration to support the body’s natural healing processes. Taking over-the-counter medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help manage fever and aches. Staying home and avoiding contact with others is crucial to prevent further spread of potential infections.
